examples.arabic: هي كانت معاها خمسين جنيه بس، يعني مش كفاية لكل القماش ده.
examples.english: She only had fifty pounds with her, meaning it wasn't enough for all this fabric.

examples.arabic: منى كان معاها خمسين جنيه بس في شنطتها؛ يعني ده سعر كويس، بس هي كانت قلقانة.
examples.english: Mona only had fifty pounds in her bag; meaning, this was a good price, but she was worried.
examples.transliteration: Mona kan ma'aha khamseen geneh bas fi shantetha; ya'ni dah se'r kwayyes, bas heya kanet 'alqana.
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

examples.arabic: هي معاها تمانين جنيه بس، وقالتله: "يا عمو، طب يعني معلش، مفيش أي حاجة أقل من كده؟ ده أنا طالبة غلبانة ومش هعرف أخلّص المشروع بتاعي من غيره."
examples.english: She only had eighty pounds, and she told him: "Uncle, well, I mean, sorry, isn't there anything less than that? I'm a poor student and I won't be able to finish my project without it."
examples.transliteration: Heya ma3aha tamaneen geneh bas, we qaletlo: "Ya 3ammo, tab ya3ni ma3lesh, mafish ay haga a'all men keda? Da ana taliba ghalabana we mesh ha3raf akhalles el-mashrou3 beta3i men gheero."

examples.arabic: إن شاء الله كاس أفريقيا ده يكون بتاعنا يا مصريين!
examples.english: God willing, this African Cup will be ours, Egyptians!
examples.transliteration: In sha Allah kas Afrika da yekoun beta3na ya Masreyyeen!

examples.arabic: قلنا لازم نتقابل قريب ان شاء الله
examples.english: We said, "We must meet again soon, God willing."
examples.transliteration: Oulna lazem net'abel 'orayeb, in sha Allah.

examples.arabic: ده يوم حلو اوي ان شاء الله
examples.english: This is a very beautiful day, God willing.
examples.transliteration: Da yōm ḥelw ʾawī in shāʾ Allāh.

examples.arabic: حتى بعد السنين دي كلها احساسنا بقي كاننا ما بعدناش

examples.transliteration: hatta baad el seneen de kolaha ehsasna baea kaenena ma baadnash

examples.arabic: بابا قال: إحنا لازم نروح السوق النهاردة يا حلوين.
examples.english: Dad said: We must go to the market today, my dears.
examples.transliteration: Baba aal: Ehna lazam narouh el soo2 ennaharda ya helwein.

examples.arabic: “مش عارفين نعمل إيه؟” قال أحمد.
examples.english: "We don't know what to do?" Ahmed said.
examples.transliteration: “Mesh 3arfin na3mel eh?” al Ahmed.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: أحمد قال: "ايوه، أنا شوفتها امبارح برضه".
examples.english: Ahmed said: "Yes, I saw her yesterday too."
examples.transliteration: Ahmed aal: "Aywa, ana shoftaha embare7 bardo."
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: هو افتكر اللي حصل امبارح وسأل عن اخواته واحلامه الكبيرة
examples.english: He remembered what happened yesterday and asked about his siblings and his big dreams
examples.transliteration: Howa eftakar elli hasal embareh we sa-al an akhwato we ahlamo el kabira

examples.english: I tried to follow the recipe well but I don't know what happened.

examples.arabic: قومت اشوف ايه اللي حصل بالظبط
examples.english: I got up to see exactly what happened.
examples.transliteration: ʔumt ashūf ēh illi ḥaṣal biẓ-ẓabṭ.

examples.arabic: انا بحب عيلتي واليوم الدافي ده
examples.english: I love my family and this warm day.
examples.transliteration: ana baheb eilety wel yom eldafy da

examples.arabic: طبعاً يا بنتي، خليهم. الشاي بتاعنا مشهور، يبقى عظيم وبنقترحه.
examples.english: Of course, my daughter, keep them. Our tea is famous, it will be great, and we recommend it.

examples.arabic: تيتا قالت يارب يبقى يوم عظيم لينا كلنا

words.english: may He have mercy on him

examples.english: I say goodbye to my family.
examples.transliteration: A'ool ma3 el salama la ahly.

examples.english: I tried on the shirt and it turned out perfect.

examples.arabic: طلع إن القطة كان عندها ميعاد مع صاحب الكلب

examples.arabic: الاكل طلع لذيذ جدا
examples.english: The food turned out very delicious.
examples.transliteration: El akl tele' lazeez geddan.

examples.arabic: يمكن نادية تعرف فني كويس يجي بسرعة
examples.english: Maybe Nadia knows a good technician who can come quickly.
examples.transliteration: Yomken Nadia te'raf fanni kowayyes yeegy be-sor'a

examples.english: He always wants to know "Why" everything.

examples.english: At work, I say hello to the cleaner.

examples.storyTitle: A Phone Call with a Friend

examples.english: Sarah became happy again and thanked the man.

examples.storyTitle: A Nice Smell from the Neighbors' Apartment

examples.transliteration: Am Hamed shawar ala ahwa qariba w qal: "Ya ebny, matqalqish. Aho, ruh ahwet el-Hag Fouad elli henaka, yumkin tala'i ab sahibak, ammo Mahmoud, howa dayman henaka el-sobh badri, w dayman biygeeb ketab ma'ah."
examples.storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: فكرت تتصل بصديقتها نادية عشان تساعدها تلاقي حد يصلحها
examples.english: She thought about calling her friend Nadia to help her find someone to fix it.
examples.transliteration: Fakkaret tettasel be-sadee'etha Nadia 'ashan tesa'edha tela'i hadd yeslahha

examples.arabic: اتمنى يوم احسن
examples.english: I wish for a better day.
examples.transliteration: Atmanna youm ahsan.

examples.arabic: ابنهم كريم بيحب يلعب كورة.
examples.english: Their son, Karim, likes to play football.
examples.transliteration: Ebnehom Karim beyehebb yel3ab kora.

examples.arabic: هو بس عايز يلعب في التليفون
examples.english: He just wants to play on the phone.
examples.transliteration: howa bas ayez yelab fi eltelefoun

examples.arabic: احمد كان ناوي يلعب حارس مرمى
examples.english: Ahmed intended to play goalkeeper.
examples.transliteration: Aḥmad kān nāwi yelʿab ḥāres marma.

examples.arabic: أحمد الصغير كان بيحب الكورة بتاعتنا جداً.
examples.english: Little Ahmed loved our football very much.
examples.transliteration: Ahmad el soghayar kan by7ebb el kora beta3tna geddan.
examples.storyTitle: Eid Joy and the African Cup in Morocco

examples.arabic: اخويا بيحب الترابيزة الكبيرة
examples.english: My brother loves the big table.
examples.transliteration: Akhouya biheb el tarabeza el kibira

examples.arabic: عمر بيحب البحر وهو فرحان قوي
examples.english: Omar loves the sea and he is very happy.
examples.transliteration: Omar beyheb el baher wa howa farhan awy

examples.arabic: شويه وصاحبي وصل وقالي يلا بينا
examples.english: A little while later, my friend arrived and told me, "Let's go."
examples.transliteration: Shwaya we sahby wasal we qali yalla beina.
examples.storyTitle: Waiting for My Friend at the Café

examples.arabic: صاحبي وصل يا دوب بعد خمس دقايق
examples.english: My friend arrived after barely five minutes
examples.transliteration: Saḥbi waṣal ya doob ba'd khamas da'aye'

examples.arabic: جدو قال إيه في يومي كان ممكن ترجع كل حاجة
examples.english: Grandpa said, "What? In my day, you could return anything!"
examples.transliteration: Geddo 'al eh fe yomi kan mumken teragga' koll haga.

examples.arabic: مريم، بعد ما حسّت إن ده أملها الأخير، قررت ترجع البيت تدور على شغلانة تانية بسرعة عشان تجمع باقي الفلوس وترجعله بكرة الصبح.
examples.english: Maryam, after feeling that this was her last hope, decided to go back home to quickly look for another job to gather the rest of the money and return to him tomorrow morning.
examples.transliteration: Maryam, ba3d ma hasset en da amalha el-akheer, qarrarat terga3 el-beit tedawwar 3ala shoghlana tanya besor3a 3ashan tagamma3 ba'i el-felous we terga3lo bokra el-sobh.

examples.arabic: هي عايزة ترجع العصير اللي اشترته امبارح
examples.english: She wants to return the juice she bought yesterday
examples.transliteration: Heya ayza terga' el-a'seer elly eshtarito embarah

examples.arabic: اعتقد البحيرة هناك هتعجبك اوي
examples.english: I think you will really like the lake there.
examples.transliteration: A3taqed el bo7eira henāk hat3agebek awi

examples.arabic: بعدين خلص الست شنط التانية في ساعتين بس.
examples.english: Then he finished the other six bags in two hours only.
examples.transliteration: Baaden khallas el-set shonat el-tanya fi saateyn bas.

examples.arabic: لما اليوم خلص ودعت صاحبتي وروحت البيت اريح شوية قبل ما اشوف جدتي
examples.english: When the day finished, I said goodbye to my friend and went home to rest a bit before seeing my grandmother
examples.transliteration: Lamma el youm khilis wadda3t saHibtī we rowwaHt el beit areyyaH shwaya qabl ma ashoof gaddeti

examples.arabic: لا مفيش لبن خلص امبارح
examples.english: No, there's no milk, it finished yesterday.
examples.transliteration: La mafish laban khalas embareh.

examples.arabic: امبارح حصلت مشكلة في البيت بين جدي واخواتي
examples.english: Yesterday a problem happened in the house between my grandpa and my siblings.
examples.transliteration: Embareh hasalet moshkela fel beit bein geddi wa akhwati.

examples.arabic: حاجة غريبة حصلت مع لعبتي القديمة
examples.english: A strange thing happened with my old toys.
examples.transliteration: ḥága ɣaríba ḥáṣalit maʕ luʕabti il-ʔadíma

examples.arabic: بعد ما روحت البيت حصلت مشكلة في الجاكت اللي اشتريته
examples.english: After I went home, a problem happened with the jacket I bought.
examples.transliteration: baʕd ma rowwaħt il-beet, ɧáȿalit muʃkila fil-gakkit illi-ʃtaraytu.

examples.arabic: مصر ضد إيران في كأس العالم، تخيل!
examples.english: Egypt against Iran in the World Cup, imagine!
examples.transliteration: Masr ded Iran fi kaas el-'alam, takhayyal!

examples.arabic: الاجازة دي هتبقى جميلة اوي
examples.english: This holiday will be very beautiful.
examples.transliteration: El agaza di hatib'a gameela awi.

examples.arabic: بفكر في رحلة للويك اند هتبقى عظيمة
examples.english: I'm thinking about a trip for the weekend, it will be great!
examples.transliteration: Bafakkar fi rehla lel week-end hatib2a 3azeema

examples.arabic: قلتله متقلقش بكرة هتبقى كويس
examples.english: I told him 'don't worry, tomorrow you will be well'.
examples.transliteration: Oltello mate'la'sh bokra hatib'a kwayyes.

examples.arabic: هو قال مفيش مشكلة وامشي طوالي لحد ما تشوف البنك
examples.english: He said no problem and go straight until you see the bank.
examples.transliteration: Howa aal mafeesh moshkela wa emshy tawaly lahad ma tshouf el bank.

examples.arabic: نزلت تشوف البواب عم سعيد موجود.
examples.english: She went down to see if the doorman Uncle Saeed was present.
examples.transliteration: Nezelet teshof el bawab amm Saeed mawgood.

examples.arabic: لكن امي قالت عايزة تشوف الخضار والفاكهة بكام عشان نختار الاحسن
examples.english: But my mother said she wants to see the vegetables and fruit to know how much they are, so we choose the best
examples.transliteration: Laken ommy aalet aayza teshuf el khodaar wel fakha bekam ashan nekhtar el ahsan

examples.arabic: عم حامد رد بابتسامة: "صباح النور يا علي! كويس الحمد لله، إيه اللي مصحيك بدري كده؟ أنت لازم تروح الدرس بتاعك؟" علي قال: "أيوه، أنا مجبور ألاقي كتاب للدرس دلوقتي، ومش لاقيه هنا. المكتبة قافلة."
examples.english: Uncle Hamed replied with a smile: "Good morning, Aly! I'm fine, thank God. What got you up so early like this? Do you have to go to your lesson?" Aly said: "Yes, I am forced to find a book for the lesson now, and I can't find it here. The bookstore is closed."
examples.transliteration: Am Hamed radd be-ebtisama: "Sabah el-noor ya Aly! Kwayyes el-hamdu lellah, eh elli masahhik badri keda? Enta lazim teruh el-dars betaak?" Aly qal: "Aywa, ana magboor ala'i ketab lel-dars delwa'ty, w mesh la'ieh hena. El-maktaba qafla."
examples.storyTitle: A Book's Journey in Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: الراجل ابتسم و قال عايز تروح المحطة
examples.english: The man smiled and said "Do you want to go to the station?"
examples.transliteration: El ragel ibtasam w aal "Ayez tarouh el mahatta?"
examples.storyTitle: Getting Lost and Asking for Directions

examples.arabic: تيتا بتحب تقعد في البيت القديم
examples.english: Grandma loves to sit in the old house.
examples.transliteration: Tiita bithebb teq'od fil-beet el-qadiim.

examples.arabic: انا بستغرب ازاي ممكن الناس تقعد ساعات تتكلم عن كل حاجة صغيرة
examples.english: I wonder how people can sit for hours talking about every small thing
examples.transliteration: Ana bastaghreb izzay mumkin en-nās tiq3od sā3āt tetkallim 3an kull ḥāga ṣughayyara

examples.arabic: فقلت اعمل شاي سخن واقعد اتفرج على فيلم جديد على نيتفليكس
examples.english: So I decided to make hot tea and sit and watch a new movie on Netflix.
examples.transliteration: fa olt aamel shay sokhn w aod atfarag ala film gedid ala netflix

examples.arabic: طلبت قهوة مضبوطة وفضلت اتفرج على الشارع والناس اللي رايحة وجاية
examples.english: I ordered a medium coffee and kept watching the street and the people coming and going.
examples.transliteration: Talabt ahwa mazboota w fadalt atfarrag 'ala esh-shari' wen-nas elly rayha w gayya

examples.arabic: في وقت فراغي انا بحب اتفرج على افلام عشان اكون مبسوطة
examples.english: In my free time, I like to watch movies to be happy
examples.transliteration: Fi wa't faraġy ana ba7ebb atfarraġ 3ala aflam 3ashan akoun mabsoota

examples.arabic: بعد ما نرجع البيت، هعمل سلطات فواكه متنوعة وهاشرب فنجان قهوة تاني مع صحباتي وهنتبسط أوي.
examples.english: After we return home, I will make various fruit salads and will drink another cup of coffee with my female friends, and we will enjoy ourselves very much.
examples.transliteration: Baʾd ma nergaʾ el beyt, haʾamel salatat fawakih metnawwaʾa w hashrah fangaan ʾahwa tany maʾa soḥabaty w hanetbaset ʾawy.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

examples.arabic: قولتله انا جعان انا هعمل اكل
examples.english: I told him I am hungry, I will cook food.
examples.transliteration: Oltelo ana gaaan ana haamel akl.

examples.arabic: انا جعان اوي النهارده انا هعمل اكل جديد
examples.english: I am very hungry today, I will cook a new dish.
examples.transliteration: Ana gaa'aan awy el naharda ana haa'mel akl gedeed.

examples.arabic: العيلة كلها قعدت على السفرة.
examples.english: The whole family sat at the dining table.
examples.transliteration: El 3eila kollaha 2a3adet 3ala el sofra.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Cooking Day in Our Home

examples.arabic: العيلة قعدت مع بعض والاكل كان حلو اوي
examples.english: The family sat together and the food was very delicious
examples.transliteration: El eila aadet maa baad wa el akl kaan helw awy

examples.arabic: كل العيلة قعدت تاكل اكل تيتا الحلو
examples.english: The whole family sat down to eat Grandma's delicious food.
examples.transliteration: Kull el-ʿēla qaʿadit tākul akl Tīta el-ḥelw.

examples.arabic: انا بقى كنت بفكر في المول الحديث اللي لسه سايباها فيه من ساعة
examples.english: As for me, I was thinking about the modern mall where I just left it an hour ago.
examples.transliteration: Ana ba'a kont bafakkar fi el mol el hadith elly lessa saybaha feih men sa'a

examples.arabic: بفكر في رحلة للويك اند هتبقى عظيمة
examples.english: I'm thinking about a trip for the weekend, it will be great!
examples.transliteration: Bafakkar fi rehla lel week-end hatib2a 3azeema

examples.arabic: هو قال فكرة كويسة اوي انا كنت لسه بفكر في اكله حلوة الجو الكويس في الربيع قصير
examples.english: He said, "That's a very good idea! I was just thinking about a nice meal. The good weather in spring is short."
examples.transliteration: Howa 'aal fekra kwayyisa awi ana kunt lessa bafakkar fi akla Helwa el-gaww el-kawayyes fi er-rabii3 'aseer.

examples.arabic: العم محمود جاب حبل طويل.
examples.english: Uncle Mahmoud brought a long rope.
examples.transliteration: El 3am Ma7moud gab 7abl tawil.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: هو جاب لنا هدايا جميلة، وإحنا فرحنا أوي بيها.
examples.english: He brought us beautiful gifts, and we were very happy with them.
examples.transliteration: Howa gab lena hadaya gamila, w e7na fara7na awi beeha.

examples.arabic: أحمد جاب علبة الشاي من مطبخه.
examples.english: Ahmed brought a tea box from his kitchen.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed gab 3elbet el shay men matbakh-o.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.english: When I went home at night, I called my friends because I get happy when I talk with them.
examples.transliteration: Lamma rowwaht beiti bel leil kallamt ashabi ashan ana bakoon mabsoot lamma batkallem ma'ahom

examples.arabic: امبارح انا روحت ازور خالتي
examples.english: Yesterday I went to visit my aunt.
examples.transliteration: Imbareh ana roht azour khalti.

examples.arabic: النهاردة روحت أزور خالتي في بيتها
examples.english: Today I went to visit my aunt at her house.
examples.transliteration: El naharda rooht azor khalty fi beitaha.

examples.arabic: انا كنت فاكر انه مصري عشان بيتكلم عربي كويس
examples.english: I thought he was Egyptian because he speaks Arabic well.
examples.transliteration: Ana kont faker inno masry ashan beyetkallem araby kwayyes.

examples.arabic: تمام مفيش اي مشكلة تعال شوف المقاس اللي يناسبك
examples.english: Okay, no problem at all, come see the size that suits you.
examples.transliteration: tamam mafish ay moshkela ta3ala shoof el-ma'as elli yenasebak

examples.arabic: لما بشوف القهوة جاية انا بكون مبسوط اوي
examples.english: When I see the coffee coming, I get very happy.
examples.transliteration: Lama bashoof el ahwa gaya ana bakoon mabsoot awy

examples.arabic: خدت تليفونه عشان نتكلم أكتر الأيام الجاية
examples.english: I took his phone so we can talk more in the coming days.
examples.transliteration: Khaddt telefoono ashan netkallem aktar el ayam el gayya

examples.arabic: “أيوه يا منى! أنا جاية حالاً دلوقتي!” ردت سارة بسرعة.
examples.english: "Yes, Mona! I'm coming right away now!" Sara replied quickly.
examples.transliteration: "Aywa ya Mona! Ana gayya halan delwa'ty!" raddet Sara be-sor'a.
examples.storyTitle: Mona's Lost Wallet at the Metro

examples.arabic: كل واحد في الحتة كان حاسس بفرحة كبيرة عشان الفريق كان بيلعب كويس.
examples.english: Every person in the area was feeling a great joy because the team was playing well.
examples.transliteration: Kol wahed fel hetta kan hases be farha kebira ashan el fariq kan beyelab kways.

examples.arabic: جدي مش فاهم الحاجة دي وفاكر ان اخويا بيلعب
examples.english: My grandpa does not understand this thing and thinks that my brother is playing.
examples.transliteration: Geddi mesh fahem el haga di wa faker en akhouya biyelab.

examples.arabic: احمد بيلعب الكورة حلو اوي
examples.english: Ahmed plays the ball very well.
examples.transliteration: ahmed beyelaab el kora helw awy

examples.arabic: انا جبت معايا علبة جاتوه
examples.english: I brought a box of cake with me.
examples.transliteration: ana gebt maaya elbet gatoh

examples.arabic: جبت الاكل عشان هو ياكل
examples.english: I brought the food so he eats.
examples.transliteration: Gebt el akl 'ashan howa yakol.

examples.arabic: في المطبخ انا جبت رز و خضار
examples.english: In the kitchen, I brought rice and vegetables.
examples.transliteration: Fi elmatbakh ana gebt rozz w khodar.

examples.arabic: قلت لنفسي افتح كتاب الطبيخ عشان ابدا بس المكونات كانت غريبة
examples.english: I told myself "open the cookbook" to start, but the ingredients were strange.
examples.transliteration: Olt le-nafsi iftah ketab el-tabkh ashan abda bas el-mokonat kanet ghariba.

examples.arabic: نادت على الجارسون وقالتله: "اِفتَح المنيو ده، إيه الكركديه فرابيتشينو ده؟"
examples.english: She called the waiter and told him: "Open this menu, what is this Karkade Frappuccino?"
examples.transliteration: Nadet 'ala el-garsoon we 'alotle: "Eftah el-menyu dah, eh el-karkadeh Frappuccino dah?"
examples.storyTitle: A Strange Drink at Zamalek Café

examples.arabic: منى قالت وانا لازم افتح الشباك عشان اشوف الشمس
examples.english: Mona said And I must open the window to see the sun.
examples.transliteration: Mona qalet wana lazim aftah el shobak 3ashan ashouf el shams.

examples.arabic: إحنا أكلنا كتيير وساعتها بابا جه.
examples.english: We ate a lot, and then my father came.
examples.transliteration: E7na akalna keteer w sa3etha baba geh.

examples.arabic: احمد جه وقال السلام عليكم صباح الخير ازيك يا سارة
examples.english: Ahmed came and said hello good morning how are you Sarah
examples.transliteration: Ahmed ga wa aal as salamu alaykum sabaah el kheer izzayyik ya Sara

examples.arabic: الشاي جه في كوباية ازاز
examples.english: The tea came in a glass cup.
examples.transliteration: el shai gah fi kobaya ezaz

examples.arabic: سارة راحت تزور طنط منى وطنت منى فتحت الباب وقالت أهلاً بيكي يا سارة
examples.english: Sara went to visit Aunt Mona and Aunt Mona opened the door and said "Welcome Sara."
examples.transliteration: Sara rahet tezour Tant Mona we Tant Mona fatahet el-bab we qalet ahlan beeki ya Sara

examples.arabic: نهلة راحت السوق عشان تشتري هدوم جديدة
examples.english: Nahla went to the market to buy new clothes.
examples.transliteration: Nahla rahet el souq ashan teshtari hedoom gedeeda.

examples.arabic: ماما راحت مع بنتها المحل
examples.english: Mama went with her daughter to the shop.
examples.transliteration: Mama rahet ma'a bentaha el mahall

examples.arabic: انا بحاول اجاوب بس ببقى تعبان بعد كل ده
examples.english: I try to answer but I get tired after all of this.
examples.transliteration: Ana bahawel agawel bas babqa ta'ban ba'd kol da.

examples.arabic: انا سمعت صوته وكنت قلقان
examples.english: I heard his voice and I was worried
examples.transliteration: ana semeat soto wa kont alaan

examples.arabic: انا سمعت صوت ضحك عالي
examples.english: I heard a loud sound of laughter.
examples.transliteration: ana semaat soot dehk aali

examples.arabic: لما وصلت البيت لقيت فيه نور في الصاله و سمعت صوت ضحك عالي
examples.english: When I arrived home, I found a light in the hall and heard loud laughter
examples.transliteration: lamma wasalt el bet laqet fih nour fi essala we sema't sot dehk 'ali
examples.storyTitle: A Day at Work and Home

examples.arabic: فجأة السما بدأت تمطر حاجات بيضا زي قطع القطن الصغيرة.
examples.english: Suddenly, the sky started raining white things like small pieces of cotton.
examples.transliteration: Fag'a el sama bada'et temattar hagat beida zay eta'a el otn el soghayara.

examples.arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اجي البيت والمطره بدأت تنزل بغزاره
examples.english: I just drove the car to come home and the rain started falling heavily.
examples.transliteration: ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan agi el bet wel matara badat tenzel be ghazara

examples.arabic: هي بدأت تتكلم بصوت عالي ايه اللي حصل امبارح بالليل كان ازعاج رهيب
examples.english: She started talking loudly: "What happened last night was terrible noise!"
examples.transliteration: Hiyya bada't tetkallem besot 'ali: "Eh elli hasal embarah bel-leil kan ez'ag rahib!"

examples.arabic: أنا حسيت إن قلبي بيتنطط من السعادة في وسط الجو الجديد ده.
examples.english: I felt that my heart was jumping from happiness in the middle of this new atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasset en alby beyetnattat men el saada fi wast el gaw el gedid da.

examples.arabic: انا حسيت بفرحه كبيره اوي
examples.english: I felt very big happiness.
examples.transliteration: Ana hasseyt be farha kebeera awi

examples.arabic: حسيت اني تهت خالص ومبقتش عارف اروح فين
examples.english: I felt completely lost and didn't know where to go.
examples.transliteration: Hassait enny teht khales wamaba'eetsh aref arouh fein.

examples.arabic: مصطفى: ماشي يا يوسف، أشوفك بكرة!
examples.english: Mostafa: Okay, Youssef, see you tomorrow!
examples.transliteration: Mostafa: Mashi ya Youssef, ashoofak bokra!

examples.arabic: قبل ما امشي قلتلها مع السلامة يا خالتي اشوفك قريب

examples.arabic: قالي انا كنت عايز أسألك لو فاضي بكرة عشان عندي ليك مفاجأة حلوة
examples.english: He told me, "I wanted to ask you if you're free tomorrow because I have a nice surprise for you."
examples.transliteration: Qal-li ana kont ʻayez as'alak law fady bokra ʻashan ʻandy leek mofaga'a helwa.

examples.arabic: ايوه، ماشي، الدراسة كويسة، معلش، كنت عايزة اسألك عن شغل.
examples.english: Yes, okay, studies are good, excuse me, I wanted to ask you about work.
examples.transliteration: Aywa, mashi, el-derasa kwayyisa, ma'alesh, kunt ayza as'alak an shoghl.

examples.arabic: انا اصحى الصبح بدري كل يوم
examples.english: I wake up early every morning.
examples.transliteration: Ana as7a el sob7 badry kol yoom.

examples.arabic: كمان شوية صاحبي هيجي
examples.english: My friend will come in a little while.
examples.transliteration: Kaman shwayya sahby hayigi

examples.arabic: حاولت اطفي الراوتر واشغله تلاتاشر مرة بس مفيش فايدة

examples.transliteration: ḥāwelt aṭaffi er-router w ašaġġalo talattāšar marra bas mafīš fāyda.

examples.arabic: صباح الخير يا عمو، معلش، ممكن أسأل عن حاجة؟

examples.transliteration: Sabah el-kheir ya ammo, ma'alesh, mumkin as'al 'an haga?

examples.arabic: انا كنت خايف شوية وقلت لازم اسال حد
examples.english: I was a little scared and I said I must ask someone.
examples.transliteration: Ana kont khayef shwayya w olt lazim as'al had.

examples.arabic: هو شاف أصحابه علي ومنى جنب محل الفاكهة.
examples.english: He saw his friends Ali and Mona next to the fruit shop.
examples.transliteration: Howa shaf ashabo Ali w Mona gamb mahl el faka.

examples.arabic: احمد شاف جاره الصبح
examples.english: Ahmad saw his neighbor in the morning.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed shaf garo el sobh

examples.english: The waiter brought the coffee quickly, and Kareem felt happy because he ordered correctly, and started to open his book to continue the lesson.

examples.arabic: النهاردة قررت تروح محل هدوم يفتح بدري
examples.english: Today she decided to go to a clothes shop that opens early.
examples.transliteration: Elnaharda qararet tiruh mahall hudum yifta badri.

examples.arabic: هاني دفع الـ 20 جنيه ومبسوط، عرف إنه لسه معاه 10 جنيه زيادة، وده جرى بسرعة.
examples.english: Hany paid the 20 pounds and was happy, he knew he still had 10 extra pounds with him, and this happened quickly.
examples.transliteration: Hany dafa3 el-20 geneh w mabsut, 3iref inno lessa ma3ah 10 geneh ziyada, w dah gara b-sor3a.

examples.arabic: هناك ممكن نقعد في مكان جميل ونتفرج على النيل
examples.english: There we might sit in a beautiful place and watch the Nile.
examples.transliteration: Henak momken na'od fi makan gameel we netfarrag 'ala el-Neel

examples.arabic: انا قلتله انا تمام الحمد لله تيجي نقعد نشرب اي مشروب و نتكلم شوية
examples.english: I told him, "I'm fine, thank God. Shall we sit and have a drink and talk a little?"
examples.transliteration: Ana 'ultelu ana tamaam el-Hamdu lillaah teegy no'od neshrab ayy mashroub w netkallim shwayya.

examples.arabic: يلا بينا! خططت نقعد على قهوة، وناكل كشري.
examples.english: Let's go! I planned for us to sit at a coffee shop, and eat koshari.

examples.arabic: ماما امرتني اخلص قبل العشا
examples.english: Mom ordered me to finish before dinner.
examples.transliteration: máma ʔamáritni áẖlaṣ ʔabl il-ʕaša

examples.english: She only had eighty pounds, and she told him: "Uncle, well, I mean, sorry, isn't there anything less than that? I'm a poor student and I won't be able to finish my project without it."
examples.transliteration: Heya ma3aha tamaneen geneh bas, we qaletlo: "Ya 3ammo, tab ya3ni ma3lesh, mafish ay haga a'all men keda? Da ana taliba ghalabana we mesh ha3raf akhalles el-mashrou3 beta3i men gheero."

examples.arabic: ابويا عايز يصلح النور دلوقتي
examples.english: My father wants to fix the light now.

examples.arabic: انا بكلم السباك عشان يصلح الماسوره دلوقتي

examples.transliteration: ana bakallem el sabbak ashan yesallah el masoora delwaqti

examples.english: My father, Abu Hassan, was trying to fix the old fan in the hall, saying, "The weather is very hot now, folks!"
examples.transliteration: Walidi, Abu Hassan, kan bihayawel yessalah el-marwaha el-adeema fel-sala, we howa bi'ool "El-gaww harr geddan delwa'ti ya gama'a!"

examples.arabic: لما بكون مبسوط بكلم اصحابي وهنحتفل في بيتي
examples.english: When I am happy, I talk to my friends, and we will celebrate at my house.
examples.transliteration: Lama bakoon mabsoot bakallem ashabi w hanhetfel fi beiti

examples.arabic: عم حسن قالها: "يا بنتي، معلش، طب خدي الكتاب ده بـ ٥٠ جنيه عشانك."
examples.english: Uncle Hassan told her: "My daughter, never mind, okay take this book for 50 EGP for you."

examples.english: I was happy that he allowed the return.

examples.transliteration: El-bayya' rahhab beena wa aal le ommi ahlan beeki ya hagga izzayyik.

examples.english: Finally I arrived late, but I was laughing.
